request, and the clock.\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\timport sqlite3\n     5\tfrom contextlib import closing\n     6\tfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n     7\tfrom pathlib import Path\n     8\t\n     9\tSCHEMA = \"\"\"\n    10\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    11\t    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    12\t    email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    13\t    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    14\t    nickname      TEXT    UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    15\t    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    16\t    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    17\t    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    18\t    updated_at    TEXT    NOT NULL\n    19\t);\n    20\t\n    21\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (\n    22\t    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    23\t    title              TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    24\t    slug               TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    25\t    body               TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    26\t    topic              TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    27\t    status             TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n    28\t                               CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    29\t    author_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    30\t    created_at         TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    31\t    updated_at         TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    32\t    first_published_at TEXT,   -- set once, never cleared; locks the slug\n    33\t    edited_at          TEXT    -- edited after publishing: \"Actualizado el …\"\n    34\t);\n    35\t\"\"\"\n    36\t\n    37\t\n    38\tdef now() -> str:\n    39\t    \"\"\"The current time in UTC, as stored in every timestamp column.\"\"\"\n    40\t    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"seconds\")\n    41\t\n    42\t\n    43\tdef connect(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    44\t    # One connection per request; FastAPI may hand it between threads.\n    45\t    conn = sqlite3.connect(path, check_same_thread=False)\n    46\t    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    47\t    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    48\t    return conn\n    49\t\n    50\t\n    51\tdef init(path: Path) -> None:\n    52\t    \"\"\"Create the tables if they do not exist yet. Safe to call every start.\"\"\"\n    53\t    with closing(connect(path)) as conn:\n    54\t        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n=================== app/accounts.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Accounts: who people are, and proving it with a password.\n     2\t\n     3\tPasswords are stored only as argon2 hashes and are never logged.\n     4\t\"\"\"\n     5\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     6\t\n     7\timport sqlite3\n     8\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n     9\t\n    10\tfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\n    11\tfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n    12\t\n    13\tfrom app import db\n    14\t\n    15\t_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n    16\t\n    17\t\n    18\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n    19\tclass User:\n    20\t    id: int\n    21\t    email: str\n    22\t    nickname: str | None\n    23\t    role: str\n    24\t    active: bool\n    25\t\n    26\t    @property\n    27\t    def is_leader(self) -> bool:\n    28\t        return self.role == \"admin\"\n    29\t\n    30\t\n    31\tdef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    32\t    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], nickname=row[\"nickname\"],\n    33\t                role=row[\"role\"], active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n    34\t\n    35\t\n    36\tdef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str, role: str,\n    37\t                nickname: str | None = None, active: bool = True) -> User:\n    38\t    now = db.now()\n    39\t    with conn:\n    40\t        cursor = conn.execute(\n    41\t            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, role, active,\"\n    42\t            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n    43\t            (email.strip(), _hasher.hash(password), nickname, role, int(active), now, now),\n    44\t        )\n    45\t    user = get_user(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    46\t    assert user is not None\n    47\t    return user\n    48\t\n    49\t\n    50\tdef get_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    51\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    52\t    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n    53\t\n    54\t\n    55\tdef active_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    56\t    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None once their account is inactive.\"\"\"\n    57\t    user = get_user(conn, user_id)\n    58\t    return user if user and user.active else None\n    59\t\n    60\t\n    61\tdef authenticate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> User | None:\n    62\t    \"\"\"The active user with this email and password, or None.\"\"\"\n    63\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email.strip(),)).fetchone()\n    64\t    if row is None or not row[\"active\"]:\n    65\t        return None\n    66\t    try:\n    67\t        _hasher.verify(row[\"password_hash\"], password)\n    68\t    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n    69\t        return None\n    70\t    return _user_from_row(row)\n    71\t\n    72\t\n    73\tdef list_users(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[User]:\n    74\t    \"\"\"Every account, the leader's first, then by email.\"\"\"\n    75\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'admin' DESC, email\").fetchall()\n    76\t    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n=================== app/policy.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Policy: the one place that says what a person may do.\n     2\t\n     3\tEvery leader-only admin route is named here, and only here. The admin gate\n     4\t(`app.web.signed_in_user`) refuses a member on any of them, and the\n     5\taccess-control test reads this set, so protecting a new leader-only route means\n     6\tadding its name below.\n     7\t\"\"\"\n     8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     9\t\n    10\tfrom app.accounts import User\n    11\tfrom app.content import Post\n    12\t\n    13\tLEADER_ONLY_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    14\t    \"users\",  # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts\n    15\t})\n    16\t\n    17\t\n    18\tdef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    19\t    return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n    20\t\n    21\t\n    22\tdef may_change_post(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    23\t    \"\"\"Save, preview or delete this post: the leader, any post; a member, only\n    24\t    their own drafts (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    25\t    return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == \"draft\")\n=================== app/content.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Content: posts, their slugs, and the post lifecycle.\n     2\t\n     3\tTopics are a fixed list here, not a table: members cannot add topics.\n     4\t\"\"\"\n     5\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     6\t\n     7\timport re\n     8\timport sqlite3\n     9\timport unicodedata\n    10\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n    11\t\n    12\tfrom app import db\n    13\tfrom app.accounts import User\n    14\t\n    15\t# Key stored in the database -> the Spanish name readers see, in the fixed order.\n    16\tTOPICS = {\n    17\t    \"match\": \"Partido\",\n    18\t    \"lineup\": \"Alineación\",\n    19\t    \"coach\": \"Técnico\",\n    20\t    \"signings\": \"Fichajes\",\n    21\t    \"fan-club-news\": \"Noticias del club de aficionados\",\n    22\t}\n    23\t\n    24\tSTATUS_NAMES = {\"draft\": \"Borrador\", \"submitted\": \"Enviada\", \"published\": \"Publicada\"}\n    25\t\n    26\tSLUG_MAX = 80\n    27\tSLUG_FALLBACK = \"publicación\"  # for a title with no letters or digits at all\n    28\t\n    29\t\n    30\tclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    31\t    \"\"\"A refused change; the message is shown to the person as it is.\"\"\"\n    32\t\n    33\t\n    34\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n    35\tclass PostFields:\n    36\t    \"\"\"What a person types into the post editor.\"\"\"\n    37\t    title: str\n    38\t    topic: str\n    39\t    body: str\n    40\t    slug: str = \"\"\n    41\t\n    42\t    @property\n    43\t    def typed_slug(self) -> str:\n    44\t        \"\"\"The slug as typed, NFC-normalized; empty when left for the title to make.\"\"\"\n    45\t        return unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", self.slug.strip())\n    46\t\n    47\t\n    48\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n    49\tclass Post:\n    50\t    id: int\n    51\t    title: str\n    52\t    slug: str\n    53\t    body: str\n    54\t    topic: str\n    55\t    status: str\n    56\t    author_id: int\n    57\t    author_nickname: str | None\n    58\t    created_at: str\n    59\t    updated_at: str\n    60\t\n    61\t    @property\n    62\t    def topic_name(self) -> str:\n    63\t        return TOPICS[self.topic]\n    64\t\n    65\t    @property\n    66\t    def status_name(self) -> str:\n    67\t        return STATUS_NAMES[self.status]\n    68\t\n    69\t\n    70\tdef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    71\t    \"\"\"NFC-normalized and lowercased; letters (accents and ñ included) and digits\n    72\t    kept; every other run of characters becomes one hyphen; at most SLUG_MAX long.\"\"\"\n    73\t    text = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", text).lower()\n    74\t    return re.sub(r\"[\\W_]+\", \"-\", text).strip(\"-\")[:SLUG_MAX].strip(\"-\") or SLUG_FALLBACK\n    75\t\n    76\t\n    77\tdef _validate(fields: PostFields) -> None:\n    78\t    if not fields.title.strip():\n    79\t        raise ContentError(\"Escribe un título.\")\n    80\t    if fields.topic not in TOPICS:\n    81\t        raise ContentError(\"Elige uno de los cinco temas.\")\n    82\t\n    83\t\n    84\tdef _slug_for(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: PostFields, post_id: int | None = None) -> str:\n    85\t    \"\"\"The slug typed into the editor, or one made from the title when left empty.\"\"\"\n    86\t    wanted = fields.typed_slug or slugify(fields.title)\n    87\t    if slugify(wanted) != wanted:\n    88\t        raise ContentError(\"El enlace solo puede tener letras minúsculas, números y guiones\"\n    89\t                           f\" sueltos, hasta {SLUG_MAX} caracteres. Por ejemplo:\"\n    90\t                           f\" {slugify(wanted)}\")\n    91\t    return _free_slug(conn, wanted, post_id)\n    92\t\n    93\t\n    94\tdef _free_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, wanted: str, post_id: int | None = None) -> str:\n    95\t    \"\"\"`wanted`, or else `wanted-2`, `wanted-3`, …: the first that no other post uses.\"\"\"\n    96\t    slug, number = wanted, 1\n    97\t    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n    98\t                       (slug, post_id)).fetchone():\n    99\t        number += 1\n   100\t        suffix = f\"-{number}\"\n   101\t        slug = wanted[:SLUG_MAX - len(suffix)].rstrip(\"-\") + suffix\n   102\t    return slug\n   103\t\n   104\t\n   105\t_SELECT = (\"SELECT posts.*, users.nickname AS author_nickname\"\n   106\t           \" FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id\")\n   107\t\n   108\t\n   109\tdef _post_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Post:\n   110\t    return Post(id=row[\"id\"], title=row[\"title\"], slug=row[\"slug\"], body=row[\"body\"],\n   111\t                topic=row[\"topic\"], status=row[\"status\"], author_id=row[\"author_id\"],\n   112\t                author_nickname=row[\"author_nickname\"], created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n   113\t                updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"])\n   114\t\n   115\t\n   116\tdef create_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, author: User, fields: PostFields) -> Post:\n   117\t    \"\"\"A new draft written by `author`.\"\"\"\n   118\t    _validate(fields)\n   119\t    now = db.now()\n   120\t    slug = _slug_for(conn, fields)\n   121\t    with conn:\n   122\t        cursor = conn.execute(\n   123\t            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, topic, status, author_id,\"\n   124\t            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?)\",\n   125\t            (fields.title, slug, fields.body, fields.topic, author.id, now, now),\n   126\t        )\n   127\t    post = get_post(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n   128\t    assert post is not None\n   129\t    return post\n   130\t\n   131\t\n   132\tdef save_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post: Post, fields: PostFields) -> Post:\n   133\t    \"\"\"Save: new title, topic, body and slug; the status stays as it is.\"\"\"\n   134\t    _validate(fields)\n   135\t    slug = _slug_for(conn, fields, post.id)\n   136\t    with conn:\n   137\t        conn.execute(\n   138\t            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, topic = ?, updated_at = ?\"\n   139\t            \" WHERE id = ?\",\n   140\t            (fields.title, slug, fields.body, fields.topic, db.now(), post.id),\n   141\t        )\n   142\t    saved = get_post(conn, post.id)\n   143\t    assert saved is not None\n   144\t    return saved\n   145\t\n   146\t\n   147\tdef delete_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post: Post) -> None:\n   148\t    with conn:\n   149\t        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post.id,))\n   150\t\n   151\t\n   152\tdef get_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int | None) -> Post | None:\n   153\t    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE posts.id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n   154\t    return _post_from_row(row) if row else None\n   155\t\n   156\t\n   157\tdef list_posts(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Post]:\n   158\t    \"\"\"Every post from every author, most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n   159\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} ORDER BY posts.updated_at DESC, posts.id DESC\").fetchall()\n   160\t    return [_post_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n=================== app/markdown.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Markdown rendering: Markdown text in, sanitized HTML out.\n     2\t\n     3\tUsed by Vista previa (and later by the review screens and the site export), so\n     4\tthe preview is always exactly what readers get.\n     5\t\"\"\"\n     6\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     7\t\n     8\timport nh3\n     9\tfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n    10\t\n    11\t_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\")\n    12\t\n    13\t# Text formatting, lists, blockquotes, code and links. Everything else goes,\n    14\t# images included: posts carry no photos.\n    15\t_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"hr\", \"strong\", \"em\", \"del\", \"s\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\",\n    16\t         \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\", \"blockquote\", \"code\", \"pre\", \"a\"}\n    17\t_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\", \"title\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"}}\n    18\t# Links keep only full addresses. Relative ones (\"/admin\", \"//elsewhere\") would\n    19\t# point somewhere else on the public site, and published HTML has no root paths.\n    20\t_URL_SCHEMES = {\"http\", \"https\", \"mailto\"}\n    21\t\n    22\t\n    23\tdef to_html(text: str) -> str:\n    24\t    return nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text), tags=_TAGS, attributes=_ATTRIBUTES,\n    25\t                     url_schemes=_URL_SCHEMES, url_relative=\"deny\",\n    26\t                     link_rel=\"noopener noreferrer\")\n=================== app/publish.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n     2\t\n     3\tT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\n     4\trender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n     5\t\n     6\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n     7\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     8\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     9\t\"\"\"\n    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    11\t\n    12\timport shutil\n    13\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n    16\t\n    17\tfrom app import settings\n    18\t\n    19\tCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n    20\t:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\n    21\tbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n    22\theader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n    23\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n    24\t\"\"\"\n    25\t\n    26\t\n    27\tdef environment() -> Environment:\n    28\t    return Environment(\n    29\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n    30\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    31\t    )\n    32\t\n    33\t\n    34\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    35\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n    36\t    if out.exists():\n    37\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    38\t    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    39\t    env = environment()\n    40\t    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    41\t    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n    42\t        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n    43\t            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n    44\t            home_path=\"index.html\",\n    45\t        )\n    46\t    )\n    47\t    return out\n=================== app/cli.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n     2\t\n     3\t    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n     4\t    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n     5\t    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n     6\t\"\"\"\n     7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     8\t\n     9\timport argparse\n    10\timport subprocess\n    11\timport sys\n    12\t\n    13\tfrom app import settings\n    14\tfrom app.publish import render_site\n    15\t\n    16\t\n    17\tdef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    18\t    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    19\t    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    20\t    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    21\t    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    22\t    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    23\t    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    24\t    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    25\t    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    26\t    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n    27\t\n    28\t    if args.command == \"serve\":\n    29\t        import uvicorn\n    30\t\n    31\t        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:create_app\", factory=True, port=args.port,\n    32\t                    reload=args.reload)\n    33\t        return 0\n    34\t\n    35\t    if args.command == \"publish\":\n    36\t        out = render_site()\n    37\t        print(f\"Wrote {out}. {"parentUuid":"a678c709-05be-4e42-97a1-78b390cf914e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"29da84bf-8b77-470c-bc75-8aae73f9a0c5","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014NjU5dVG4NDPDFVCsRoPS9","type":"tool_result","content":"docs/handoff:\n\ndocs/process:\n(eval):1: no matches found: docs/handoff/*\n----\nauthor:\tmaxillamas06-arch\nassociation:\towner\nedited:\tfalse\nstatus:\tnone\n--\n## `/code-review` findings for T02, and how each was resolved\n\nTwo-axis review (`mattpocock-skills:code-review`) of the working tree against `f9475b7`. A separate sub-agent ran each axis. After the fixes: **94 tests pass**, and mypy reports no issues in `app/`, the seed, or the T01/T02 test files it checked. `tests/conftest.py` still shows the 5 mypy errors in T01's `routes` fixture that were already there at `f9475b7`; this ticket added none.\n\n### Standards\n\nNo hard violations. Checked: CSRF on every new POST form (save, *Vista previa*, delete), Markdown sanitized before `|safe`, no new dependency, no secrets, `site/` untouched, every file under 500 lines, no commented-out code.\n\n| # | Finding | Kind | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| S1 | `markdown.to_html` kept root-absolute links (`[a](/admin)`, `//elsewhere`). Once the export uses it, that breaks \"Published HTML uses relative paths only\" (CLAUDE.md, rubric F2) | documented standard, at risk | **Fixed, test first.** nh3 `url_relative=\"deny\"`: links keep only full `http(s)`/`mailto` addresses. `test_vista_previa_drops_root_absolute_links_so_published_html_stays_relative`. |\n| S2 | `_check` reuses the glossary's \"check\" (the leader's review); `editor()` reuses the *editor* role | judgement call: Mysterious Name / glossary | **Fixed.** Renamed to `_validate` and `render_post_form`. |\n| S3 | *Enlace* (slug) and *Vista previa* had no glossary entry | judgement call (domain.md) | **Fixed.** Added **Slug** (*Enlace*) and **Preview** (*Vista previa*) to `CONTEXT.md`. |\n| S4 | Post status is a bare string in the schema, `STATUS_NAMES`, the INSERT and Policy | judgement call: Primitive Obsession | **Deferred to T03** (#4). In T02, save and delete never change a status; T03 brings the first transition (publish), and the `Status` type belongs with that transition table. (T01's role finding was deferred the same way.) |\n| S5 | New vs. existing post: `if post` branches in the editor template; similar create/save and preview routes | judgement call: Repeated Switches / Duplicated Code | **Partly fixed.** The heading is set once. The rest stays: create and save call different Content functions with different messages, and each preview route is one line. |\n| S6 | The meta line was copied between the editor and the read-only view | judgement call: Duplicated Code | **Fixed.** Both now include `admin/_post_meta.html`. |\n| S7 | Test files imported helpers from other test files; the logout filter was repeated | judgement call | **Fixed.** `cells`, `env_example` and `run_seed` are now \"return a function\" fixtures in `conftest.py` (T01's tests use them too), and `form_actions` drops the Salir form itself. |\n| S8 | Two tests set a post's status with SQL instead of HTTP | judgement call (spec Testing Decisions) | **Kept.** This follows T01, which set `active = 0` in storage. One helper, `set_every_post_status`, does it, and its comment names T03/T04 as the tickets whose buttons replace it. |\n| S9 | The `slugify` docstring hard-coded 80; the fallback `or SLUG_FALLBACK` was repeated | low | **Fixed.** The docstring refers to `SLUG_MAX`, and the fallback now lives inside `slugify`. |\n\n### Spec\n\nAll nine acceptance criteria of #3 are met, each by a test named after it. No scope creep found.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| P1 | \"The post lifecycle as an explicit set of transitions… refused here, not in the routes\": `content.save_post` and `delete_post` accept any status | **Kept, with reasons.** In T02, save and delete never change a status, so Content has no transition to refuse yet. The spec gives \"may this person do this action to this item? … from role, ownership and status\" to Policy, and `policy.may_change_post` is where that check lives. T03 (#4) adds the first status transitions to Content. T05 (#6) splits Save from Delete when *Propose edit* arrives. |\n| P2 | \"The leader can edit any post\" was tested only on a member's draft | **Fixed.** `test_leader_edits_any_post_whatever_its_status` (submitted and published). |\n| P3 | `GET /admin/posts/abc` returned 422 as English JSON (against \"every error shows a message\", \"unknown ids get 404\") | **Fixed, test first.** A non-numeric id is treated as unknown: the Spanish 404 page, with the admin menu. |\n| P4 | \"Every write route asks [Policy]\": creating a post doesn't | **Kept.** It does ask: `signed_in_user` calls `policy.may_use_route` on every admin route, `create_post` included, and every signed-in person may write a post. A separate always-true function would be Speculative Generality. |\n| P5 | A taken manual slug became `uno-2` with no word to the person | **Fixed, test first.** The save message says so: *\"El enlace «uno» ya era de otra publicación: quedó «uno-2».\"* |\n| P6 | The leader saw *Guardar borrador* on non-drafts; the help text \"hasta que la publicación se publique\" echoes itself | **Fixed.** The button reads *Guardar cambios* on a post that isn't a draft; the help text is reworded; `CONTEXT.md` now notes that *publicación* is always the thing, never the act of publishing. |\n\n**Summary:** 9 Standards findings (the worst is S1, root-absolute links that would break the export's relative paths; fixed) and 6 Spec findings (the worst is P1, lifecycle transitions not in Content; kept for T02 with reasons, and T03 picks it up).\n\n--","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"c67461e6-dba7-4857-9f63-aed0d7bf75c4","timestamp":"2026-10-10T20:50:24.192Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"docs/handoff:\n\ndocs/process:\n(eval):1: no matches found: docs/handoff/*\n----\nauthor:\tmaxillamas06-arch\nassociation:\towner\nedited:\tfalse\nstatus:\tnone\n--\n## `/code-review` findings for T02, and how each was resolved\n\nTwo-axis review (`mattpocock-skills:code-review`) of the working tree against `f9475b7`. {"parentUuid":"a8992c24-39c9-427d-beff-3d2da2a44884","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"29da84bf-8b77-470c-bc75-8aae73f9a0c5","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01KDGD5eacP9Ltdk6L4PngbE","type":"tool_result","content":"================ #5\nT04: Members submit posts and the leader works a review queue\n## Parent\n\n#1\n\n## What to build\n\nA member who has finished a draft submits it to the leader; until the leader acts, the member can withdraw it. The leader works through a review queue: publish, or send back to draft. The dashboard shows the counts, and the content list filters by status and topic.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A member submits their own draft; it becomes submitted. The member can withdraw their own submitted post back to draft.\n- [ ] A member cannot edit a submitted post directly (direct POST returns 403); they withdraw it first.\n- [ ] The leader can publish a submitted post or send it back to draft.\n- [ ] Members cannot send back or publish: direct POSTs return 403.\n- [ ] Submitted posts never appear in the export.\n- [ ] The dashboard shows counts of drafts, submitted posts (labelled as waiting for review) and published posts.\n- [ ] The content list filters by status and by topic.\n- [ ] The seed adds one submitted post.\n\n## Blocked by\n================ #6\nT05: Members propose edits to published posts; the leader approves or sends them back\n## Parent\n\n#1\n\n## What to build\n\nA member changes their own published post without taking it offline: the change waits as a pending edit while the published version stays public. The leader reviews the two side by side and approves or sends it back. Approved changes show *Actualizado el …* to readers.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A member saving changes to their own published post creates a pending edit (title, topic, body); the published version is unchanged in the admin console and in the export.\n- [ ] Saving again replaces the pending edit: a post has at most one.\n- [ ] A pending edit never changes the slug.\n- [ ] The leader sees the published version and the pending edit side by side. *Approve* replaces title, topic and body, removes the pending edit and marks the post as edited after publishing; the next export shows *Actualizado el …*.\n- [ ] *Send back* removes the pending edit and leaves the published version untouched.\n- [ ] Unpublishing a post with a pending edit is refused with a message.\n- [ ] The leader's direct edit of a published post saves immediately and marks it as edited after publishing.\n- [ ] Members cannot approve or send back, and cannot propose edits to another member's post: direct POSTs return 403.\n- [ ] Pending edits never appear in the export. Deleting a post deletes its pending edit.\n- [ ] The dashboard counts pending edits, and the content list can filter to posts with a pending edit.\n- [ ] The seed adds one published post with a pending edit.\n\n## Blocked by\n================ #7\nT06: The leader manages pages and they appear in the public menu\n## Parent\n\n#1\n\n## What to build\n\nThe leader writes the fan club's own pages (*Quiénes somos*, *Próximos partidos*, *Reglas de la casa*, *Cómo unirse*), orders them, and publishes them. Published pages appear in the public menu on every page. Members never see pages in the admin console.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] The leader creates, edits, publishes, unpublishes and deletes pages (title, slug, Markdown body, draft/published, menu-order number, author, timestamps); deleting asks for confirmation.\n- [ ] Page slugs follow the post slug rules, are unique among pages, and refuse the reserved names `index`, `tema`, `posts`, `style`.\n- [ ] The page editor has *Vista previa* using the same sanitizer as posts.\n- [ ] Every page route is leader-only and covered by the access-control test; members see no pages in their menu or content list.\n- [ ] The export writes each published page at the site root; every public page's menu lists *Inicio* followed by published pages in menu order; draft pages appear nowhere.\n- [ ] The leader's content list filters posts vs pages, and the dashboard shows the page count.\n- [ ] The seed adds the four pages, published, in menu order; *Reglas de la casa* spells out the house rules and *Cómo unirse* gives `unete@albiazul.example`.\n\n## Blocked by\n================ #9\nT08: The leader updates the site with one button, and the site gets its final look\n## Parent\n\n#1\n\n## What to build\n\nThe leader puts every published change online with one *Actualizar el sitio* button, no terminal needed, and sees in plain Spanish what happened. The public site gets its finished look: a Cerro de la Silla banner on the home page and a stadium silhouette above the disclaimer, readable on a phone.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A leader-only *Actualizar el sitio* POST (with CSRF token) runs the export and then the upload, and reports each step (*\"Sitio generado ✓ · Subido a GitHub ✓\"*); if the upload fails it shows a plain Spanish error and the successful export still counts.\n- [ ] The time of the last successful export is recorded and shown on the dashboard.\n- [ ] Tests replace the upload with a fake; no test pushes to GitHub. Members get 403 (access-control test).\n- [ ] `uv run cms publish` and `uv run cms deploy` still work as before.\n- [ ] The home page has an original inline Cerro de la Silla banner and every public page has a generic stadium silhouette above the disclaimer; no image files, crest, logos or photos are used.\n- [ ] Manual: no horizontal overflow at 390 px on the public home page, the dashboard, the content list and the post editor.\n- [ ] The seed matches the spec's demo data list and runs clean from `.env.example` values.\n\n## Blocked by","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"848f3cfb-a760-4de7-9b84-f6f6dec89399","timestamp":"2026-10-10T20:52:02.500Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"================ #5\nT04: Members submit posts and the leader works a review queue\n## Parent\n\n#1\n\n## What to build\n\nA member who has finished a draft submits it to the leader; until the leader acts, the member can withdraw it. Approved changes show *Actualizado el …* to readers.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A member saving changes to their own published post creates a pending edit (title, topic, body); the published version is unchanged in the admin console and in the export.\n- [ ] Saving again replaces the pending edit: a post has at most one.\n- [ ] A pending edit never changes the slug.\n- [ ] The leader sees the published version and the pending edit side by side. *Approve* replaces title, topic and body, removes the pending edit and marks the post as edited after publishing; the next export shows *Actualizado el …*.\n- [ ] *Send back* removes the pending edit and leaves the published version untouched.\n- [ ] Unpublishing a post with a pending edit is refused with a message.\n- [ ] The leader's direct edit of a published post saves immediately and marks it as edited after publishing.\n- [ ] Members cannot approve or send back, and cannot propose edits to another member's post: direct POSTs return 403.\n- [ ] Pending edits never appear in the export. Deleting a post deletes its pending edit.\n- [ ] The dashboard counts pending edits, and the content list can filter to posts with a pending edit.\n- [ ] The seed adds one published post with a pending edit.\n\n## Blocked by\n================ #7\nT06: The leader manages pages and they appear in the public menu\n## Parent\n\n#1\n\n## What to build\n\nThe leader writes the fan club's own pages (*Quiénes somos*, *Próximos partidos*, *Reglas de la casa*, *Cómo unirse*), orders them, and publishes them. Published pages appear in the public menu on every page. Members never see pages in the admin console.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] The leader creates, edits, publishes, unpublishes and deletes pages (title, slug, Markdown body, draft/published, menu-order number, author, timestamps); deleting asks for confirmation.\n- [ ] Page slugs follow the post slug rules, are unique among pages, and refuse the reserved names `index`, `tema`, `posts`, `style`.\n- [ ] The page editor has *Vista previa* using the same sanitizer as posts.\n- [ ] Every page route is leader-only and covered by the access-control test; members see no pages in their menu or content list.\n- [ ] The export writes each published page at the site root; every public page's menu lists *Inicio* followed by published pages in menu order; draft pages appear nowhere.\n- [ ] The leader's content list filters posts vs pages, and the dashboard shows the page count.\n- [ ] The seed adds the four pages, published, in menu order; *Reglas de la casa* spells out the house rules and *Cómo unirse* gives `unete@albiazul.example`.\n\n## Blocked by\n================ #9\nT08: The leader updates the site with one button, and the site gets its final look\n## Parent\n\n#1\n\n## What to build\n\nThe leader puts every published change online with one *Actualizar el sitio* button, no terminal needed, and sees in plain Spanish what happened. The public site gets its finished look: a Cerro de la Silla banner on the home page and a stadium silhouette above the disclaimer, readable on a phone.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A leader-only *Actualizar el sitio* POST (with CSRF token) runs the export and then the upload, and reports each step (*\"Sitio generado ✓ · Subido a GitHub ✓\"*); if the upload fails it shows a plain Spanish error and the successful export still counts.\n- [ ] The time of the last successful export is recorded and shown on the dashboard.\n- [ ] Tests replace the upload with a fake; no test pushes to GitHub. {"parentUuid":"80ef1086-b66c-465a-b105-e47abd1d92f3","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"29da84bf-8b77-470c-bc75-8aae73f9a0c5","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01QC6uZwH6RAQ81WibApLHow","type":"tool_result","content":"# IPHS 400 — Mini-Project #2 starter (Web CMS)\n\nClick **Use this template** → name your repo **`iphs400-mp2-cms`** → make it **Public**.\nDo not fork: a fork arrives without an Issues tab, and your tickets live in Issues.\n\n## Start here\n\n1. `docs/manual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md` — the manual. Read Part 0 and Part 1 first.\n2. `docs/mp2-grading-rubric_20260922.md` — how you are graded. Read it **before** you build.\n3. `docs/mp2-setup_context-threshold-hook_20260922.md` — Exercise A, in Part 4 of the manual.\n\n## Run it\n\n```bash\nuv sync\ncp .env.example .env                  # optional: without it, .env.example is used\nuv run python scripts/seed_demo.py    # wipes and rebuilds cms.db with demo accounts\nuv run cms serve                      # then open http://localhost:8000/admin\n```\n\nDemo accounts (all fictional; passwords are the values in `.env`):\n\n| Email | Role | Nickname | Password |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `lider@albiazul.example` | leader (admin) | El Capi | `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` |\n| `ana@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Rayada de Corazón | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n| `beto@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Furia del Cerro | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n\nThe seed also adds one draft post written by Rayada de Corazón (open *Publicaciones*).\n\n## What is here\n\n```text\n.claude/hooks/     the context meter and usage ledger (Exercise A lives in ctx_guard.py)\nscripts/           usage_report.py (Exercise B lives in spend()), check_submission.py, seed_demo.py\ntests/             the exercise tests, plus helpers such as client_as(\"editor\")\napp/, templates/   the T00 skeleton — every CMS feature is yours to build\ndocs/adr/          two example decision records\n```\n\nTwo functions are deliberately unfinished and their tests fail until you write them:\n`decide()` in `.claude/hooks/ctx_guard.py` and `spend()` in `scripts/usage_report.py`.\nBoth are graded. Use `/tdd`, as the manual says.\n\n## Deadlines\n\nStage 1 (`mp2-mvp` tag): Tue Sep 29, 2:40 pm Eastern (soft target).\nStage 2 (`mp2-final` tag): Tue Oct 6, 2:40 pm Eastern, grace until Wed Oct 7, 2:40 pm.\n\nRun `uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2` before you submit.\n\n## Generative AI Use Statement\n\n*(Required. Replace this section: name the models and skills you used, quote two\nprompts you really sent, describe one real model failure, and include a\n\"Backends used\" table if you ever switched providers.)*\n\n**T4 — Security probes (D).**\n\n- D1: read the seeded database; check hash prefixes (`$argon2`, `$2b$`).\n- D2: for every form found in T3, replay its POST without the CSRF field.\n- D3: locate access-control tests; list admin-only routes from the app's router; check coverage; run them.\n- D4: create a post with `<script>window.__xss=1</script>` and `<img src=x onerror=\"window.__xss=2\">`; publish; load the admin preview and the exported page; check `window.__xss` is undefined.\n- D5: `git log --all -p | grep -E '(sk-|api[_-]?key|SECRET|PASSWORD=)'`, plus a search for committed `.env` or `*.db` files.\n\n**T5 — Tests and code (E).** Run `uv run pytest -q` and record the pass rate. Sample 3 closed tickets; map each acceptance criterion to tests. Measure file lengths; look for large commented-out blocks. Run the seed script from `.env.example`.\n\n**T6 — Public site (F1, F2, S1.7).** Fetch the Pages URL over HTTPS; crawl all internal links; grep the `gh-pages` branch for `href=\"/` and `src=\"/`.\n\n**T7 — Prose review (A1–A4, G1–G2).** Read the report, the README statement, the field notes, `CONTEXT.md`, and the grill transcripts. For A1, list the 10 sampled answers verbatim with your verdict on each. For A3 and A4, quote every tell and every human-authorship marker with its location. For G1, check each claim in the report against the repo and list any claim you could not verify.\n\n**T8 — Assemble.** Emit the item JSON, a draft feedback report using the section 6 template, and the deferred questions for this student.\n\n### 11. Deferred-question triggers\n\nA worker adds a deferred question, and does not decide, whenever:\n\n|---|---|---|\n| `! [rejected] … fetch first` | GitHub has commits you do not | `git pull --rebase` then push again |\n| `gh: not logged in` | token expired | `gh auth login` |\n| Issue did not close | commit message lacked `Closes #N` | `gh issue close 3 --comment \"closed by <sha>\"`, and use the exact phrase next time |\n| `detached HEAD` | you checked out a commit or tag | `git checkout main` |\n| Committed `cms.db` or `.env` | gitignore bypassed | tell Claude: *\"remove cms.db from git tracking and history, keep the local file\"* — then check `git log --all -p` |\n| Push rejected: secret detected | a key reached a commit | rotate the key first, then ask Claude to rewrite history |\n\n---\n\n## Part 7 — Publish to GitHub Pages\n\n**Time: 30 min. Do this in Stage 1, not at the end.**\n\n```bash\nuv run cms publish          # renders site/ from published rows\nuv run cms deploy           # pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch\n```\n\nThen, once, on GitHub: **Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Deploy from a branch → `gh-pages` / root → Save**. Wait up to 10 minutes, then open `https://<username>.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/`.\n\n**Relative paths matter.** Your site lives in a subfolder, so `/style.css` (leading slash) breaks while `style.css` and `../style.css` work. In MP1 seven sites would have broken on deploy for exactly this reason. Check before you submit:\n\n```bash\ngit grep -n 'href=\"/\\|src=\"/' gh-pages -- '*.html' | head\n```\n\n**Expected:** no output.\n\n| Symptom | Fix |\n|---|---|\n| 404 after 10 minutes | Pages not enabled, or wrong branch selected |\n| Page loads, no CSS | root-absolute paths; see above |\n| Old content | you edited rows but did not re-run `cms publish` |\n| Draft content is public | your publish step is not filtering on status — that is a bug, and a security-ish one |\n\n---\n\n## Part 8 — Submitting\n\n### 8.1 Stage 1 (Tue Sep 29)\n{\"url\":\"https://github.com/maxillamas06-arch/iphs400-mp2-cms\",\"visibility\":\"PUBLIC\"}","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"140382b5-e89f-41be-82cc-7913f171c9ef","timestamp":"2026-10-10T20:52:12.557Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"# IPHS 400 — Mini-Project #2 starter (Web CMS)\n\nClick **Use this template** → name your repo **`iphs400-mp2-cms`** → make it **Public**.\nDo not fork: a fork arrives without an Issues tab, and your tickets live in Issues.\n\n## Start here\n\n1. `docs/manual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md` — the manual. For A1, list the 10 sampled answers verbatim with your verdict on each. For A3 and A4, quote every tell and every human-authorship marker with its location. For G1, check each claim in the report against the repo and list any claim you could not verify.\n\n**T8 — Assemble.** Emit the item JSON, a draft feedback report using the section 6 template, and the deferred questions for this student.\n\n### 11. Deferred-question triggers\n\nA worker adds a deferred question, and does not decide, whenever:\n\n|---|---|---|\n| `! [rejected] … fetch first` | GitHub has commits you do not | `git pull --rebase` then push again |\n| `gh: not logged in` | token expired | `gh auth login` |\n| Issue did not close | commit message lacked `Closes #N` | `gh issue close 3 --comment \"closed by <sha>\"`, and use the exact phrase next time |\n| `detached HEAD` | you checked out a commit or tag | `git checkout main` |\n| Committed `cms.db` or `.env` | gitignore bypassed | tell Claude: *\"remove cms.db from git tracking and history, keep the local file\"* — then check `git log --all -p` |\n| Push rejected: secret detected | a key reached a commit | rotate the key first, then ask Claude to rewrite history |\n\n---\n\n## Part 7 — Publish to GitHub Pages\n\n**Time: 30 min. Do this in Stage 1, not at the end.**\n\n```bash\nuv run cms publish          # renders site/ from published rows\nuv run cms deploy           # pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch\n```\n\nThen, once, on GitHub: **Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Deploy from a branch → `gh-pages` / root → Save**. Wait up to 10 minutes, then open `https://<username>.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/`.\n\n**Relative paths matter.** Your site lives in a subfolder, so `/style.css` (leading slash) breaks while `style.css` and `../style.css` work. In MP1 seven sites would have broken on deploy for exactly this reason. Check before you submit:\n\n```bash\ngit grep -n 'href=\"/\\|src=\"/' gh-pages -- '*.html' | head\n```\n\n**Expected:** no output.\n\n| Symptom | Fix |\n|---|---|\n| 404 after 10 minutes | Pages not enabled, or wrong branch selected |\n| Page loads, no CSS | root-absolute paths; see above |\n| Old content | you edited rows but did not re-run `cms publish` |\n| Draft content is public | your publish step is not filtering on status — that is a bug, and a security-ish one |\n\n---\n\n## Part 8 — Submitting\n\n### 8.1 Stage 1 (Tue Sep 29)\n{\"url\":\"https://github.com/maxillamas06-arch/iphs400-mp2-cms\",\"visibility\":\"PUBLIC\"}","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"80ef1086-b66c-465a-b105-e47abd1d92f3","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"616c13ec-bcd7-460e-a016-8152d9676f65","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"17671827-76e8-4afa-bcd4-bc1878449b5e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"29da84bf-8b77-470c-bc75-8aae73f9a0c5","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/maximo/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\"\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"5f99bcda-5035-4f4c-9386-49f81c86d579","timestamp":"2026-10-10T20:52:12.577Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_0127So9ApF9QcJhdVHCTjo2X","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"616c13ec-bcd7-460e-a016-8152d9676f65","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"22c1577e-f78b-4163-b16a-36c980991219","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"29da84bf-8b77-470c-bc75-8aae73f9a0c5","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BieVwmoAtWajJ9tkxPqNr6","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"f3149bc8-7705-4c5e-a5da-64d9f5858774","timestamp":"2026-10-10T20:56:02.694Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py","oldString":"    \"fan-club-news\": \"Noticias del club de aficionados\",\n}\n\n\n\nclass Status(StrEnum):","newString":"    \"fan-club-news\": \"Noticias del club de aficionados\",\n}\n\n\nclass Status(StrEnum):","originalFile":"\"\"\"Content: posts, their slugs, and the post lifecycle.\n\nTopics are a fixed list here, not a table: members cannot add topics.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom enum import StrEnum\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n# Key stored in the database -> the Spanish name readers see, in the fixed order.\nTOPICS = {\n    \"match\": \"Partido\",\n    \"lineup\": \"Alineación\",\n    \"coach\": \"Técnico\",\n    \"signings\": \"Fichajes\",\n    \"fan-club-news\": \"Noticias del club de aficionados\",\n}\n\n\n\nclass Status(StrEnum):\n    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n    SUBMITTED = \"submitted\"\n    PUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\nSTATUS_NAMES = {Status.DRAFT: \"Borrador\", Status.SUBMITTED: \"Enviada\",\n                Status.PUBLISHED: \"Publicada\"}\n\nSLUG_MAX = 80\nSLUG_FALLBACK = \"publicación\"  # for a title with no letters or digits at all\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A refused change; the message is shown to the person as it is.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Transition:\n    starts: frozenset[Status]  # the statuses this action may start from\n    leads_to: Status\n    refused: str               # shown when the post's status is not one of `starts`\n\n\n# The post lifecycle (spec #1). Who may take each action is Policy's question;\n# this table only says which moves exist.\nLIFECYCLE = {\n    \"publish\": Transition(frozenset({Status.DRAFT, Status.SUBMITTED}), Status.PUBLISHED,\n                          \"Esta publicación ya está publicada.\"),\n}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass PostFields:\n    \"\"\"What a person types into the post editor.\"\"\"\n    title: str\n    topic: str\n    body: str\n    slug: str = \"\"\n\n    @property\n    def typed_slug(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The slug as typed, NFC-normalized; empty when left for the title to make.\"\"\"\n        return unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", self.slug.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Post:\n    id: int\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    topic: str\n    status: Status\n    author_id: int\n    author_nickname: str | None\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def topic_name(self) -> str:\n        return TOPICS[self.topic]\n\n    @property\n    def status_name(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_NAMES[self.status]\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"NFC-normalized and lowercased; letters (accents and ñ included) and digits\n    kept; every other run of characters becomes one hyphen; at most SLUG_MAX long.\"\"\"\n    text = unicodedata.normalize(\"NFC\", text).lower()\n    return re.sub(r\"[\\W_]+\", \"-\", text).strip(\"-\")[:SLUG_MAX].strip(\"-\") or SLUG_FALLBACK\n\n\ndef _validate(fields: PostFields) -> None:\n    if not fields.title.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Escribe un título.\")\n    if fields.topic not in TOPICS:\n        raise ContentError(\"Elige uno de los cinco temas.\")\n\n\ndef _slug_for(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: PostFields, post_id: int | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The slug typed into the editor, or one made from the title when left empty.\"\"\"\n    wanted = fields.typed_slug or slugify(fields.title)\n    if slugify(wanted) != wanted:\n        raise ContentError(\"El enlace solo puede tener letras minúsculas, números y guiones\"\n                           f\" sueltos, hasta {SLUG_MAX} caracteres. Por ejemplo:\"\n                           f\" {slugify(wanted)}\")\n    return _free_slug(conn, wanted, post_id)\n\n\ndef _free_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, wanted: str, post_id: int | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`wanted`, or else `wanted-2`, `wanted-3`, …: the first that no other post uses.\"\"\"\n    slug, number = wanted, 1\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                       (slug, post_id)).fetchone():\n        number += 1\n        suffix = f\"-{number}\"\n        slug = wanted[:SLUG_MAX - len(suffix)].rstrip(\"-\") + suffix\n    return slug\n\n\n_SELECT = (\"SELECT posts.*, users.nickname AS author_nickname\"\n           \" FROM posts JOIN users ON users.id = posts.author_id\")\n\n\ndef _post_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Post:\n    return Post(id=row[\"id\"], title=row[\"title\"], slug=row[\"slug\"], body=row[\"body\"],\n                topic=row[\"topic\"], status=Status(row[\"status\"]), author_id=row[\"author_id\"],\n                author_nickname=row[\"author_nickname\"], created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n                updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"])\n\n\ndef create_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, author: User, fields: PostFields) -> Post:\n    \"\"\"A new draft written by `author`.\"\"\"\n    _validate(fields)\n    now = db.now()\n    slug = _slug_for(conn, fields)\n    with conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, topic, status, author_id,\"\n            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (fields.title, slug, fields.body, fields.topic, author.id, now, now),\n        )\n    post = get_post(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    assert post is not None\n    return post\n\n\ndef save_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post: Post, fields: PostFields) -> Post:\n    \"\"\"Save: new title, topic, body and slug; the status stays as it is.\"\"\"\n    _validate(fields)\n    slug = _slug_for(conn, fields, post.id)\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, topic = ?, updated_at = ?\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\",\n            (fields.title, slug, fields.body, fields.topic, db.now(), post.id),\n        )\n    saved = get_post(conn, post.id)\n    assert saved is not None\n    return saved\n\n\ndef publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post: Post) -> Post:\n    \"\"\"Publish: readers see it from the next site update on.\"\"\"\n    return _move(conn, post, \"publish\")\n\n\ndef _move(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post: Post, action: str) -> Post:\n    \"\"\"Take a lifecycle action, refused unless the post's status allows it.\"\"\"\n    transition = LIFECYCLE[action]\n    if post.status not in transition.starts:\n        raise ContentError(transition.refused)\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (transition.leads_to, db.now(), post.id))\n    moved = get_post(conn, post.id)\n    assert moved is not None\n    return moved\n\n\ndef delete_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post: Post) -> None:\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post.id,))\n\n\ndef get_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int | None) -> Post | None:\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE posts.id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _post_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef list_posts(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Post]:\n    \"\"\"Every post from every author, most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} ORDER BY posts.updated_at DESC, posts.id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [_post_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":23,"oldLines":7,"newStart":23,"newLines":6,"lines":[" }"," "," ","-"," class Status(StrEnum):","     DRAFT = \"draft\"","     SUBMITTED = \"submitted\""]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"22c1577e-f78b-4163-b16a-36c980991219","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"616c13ec-bcd7-460e-a016-8152d9676f65","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

19:15 on the 4th in Monterrey\n    take_action(leader, url, \"publish\")\n\n    post = article((export() / \"posts\" / \"crónica-del-clásico-regio.html\").read_text())\n\n    assert \"<h1>Crónica del Clásico Regio</h1>\" in post\n    assert \"Rayada de Corazón\" in post\n    assert '<a href=\"../tema/partido.html\">Partido</a>' in post\n    assert \"Publicado el 4 de octubre de 2026\" in post\n    assert \"<strong>3-1</strong>\" in post\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d31934b5-71e7-48df-bf60-a9c258ab3b23","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"616c13ec-bcd7-460e-a016-8152d9676f65","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"b281c9da-14a3-4909-ae14-e4574a732671","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfuE6g6xZTaZ8JQr5j4Hg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NA8xUEMPotKAR6r2CGr6qU","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/export.py","content":"\"\"\"Site export: the public site, written as static HTML from published posts only.\n\n`cms publish` calls export_site(). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written. A draft that reaches the output is a bug.\n  2. Every href is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"../posts/x.html\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves the site from a subfolder. Links are\n     percent-encoded too, so slugs with accents and ñ never break.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content, markdown, settings\nfrom app.content import Post\nfrom app.dates import spanish_date\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TopicPage:\n    \"\"\"A topic's public page: every published post filed under it, newest first.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    path: str  # where it is written, from the site root: \"tema/alineación.html\"\n    posts: list[Post]\n\n\ndef post_path(post: Post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a post's page is written, from the site root.\"\"\"\n    return f\"posts/{post.slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef export_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection, out: Path) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Wipe `out` and write the public site into it; returns how many posts it holds.\"\"\"\n    posts = content.published_posts(conn)\n    topics = {key: TopicPage(name, f\"tema/{content.slugify(name)}.html\",\n                             [post for post in posts if post.topic == key])\n              for key, name in content.TOPICS.items()}\n\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    shutil.copyfile(settings.TEMPLATES / \"public\" / \"style.css\", out / \"style.css\")\n    env = _environment(topics=list(topics.values()))\n    _write(env, out, \"index.html\", \"public/home.html\")\n    for post in posts:\n        _write(env, out, post_path(post), \"public/post.html\", post=post,\n               topic=topics[post.topic], body_html=markdown.to_html(post.body))\n    return len(posts)\n\n\ndef _environment(**shared: Any) -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n                      autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]))\n    env.filters[\"spanish_date\"] = spanish_date\n    env.globals.update(site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE, post_path=post_path, **shared)\n    return env\n\n\ndef _write(env: Environment, out: Path, path: str, template: str, **context: Any) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Render one page to `out / path`. Its links go through href(), which turns a\n    path from the site root into one relative to this page, percent-encoded.\"\"\"\n    up = \"../\" * path.count(\"/\")\n\n    def href(target: str) -> str:\n        return up + quote(target)\n\n    file = out / path\n    file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    file.write_text(env.get_template(template).render(href=href, **context), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1062,"cache_read_input_tokens":171600,"output_tokens":6427,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":4766},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1062,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":6427,"cache_read_input_tokens":171600,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1062,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1062},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01NA8xUEMPotKAR6r2CGr6qU":{"file_path":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/export.py","content":"\"\"\"Site export: the public site, written as static HTML from published posts only.\n\n`cms publish` calls export_site(). Links are\n     percent-encoded too, so slugs with accents and ñ never break.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content, markdown, settings\nfrom app.content import Post\nfrom app.dates import spanish_date\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TopicPage:\n    \"\"\"A topic's public page: every published post filed under it, newest first.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    path: str  # where it is written, from the site root: \"tema/alineación.html\"\n    posts: list[Post]\n\n\ndef post_path(post: Post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a post's page is written, from the site root.\"\"\"\n    return f\"posts/{post.slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef export_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection, out: Path) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Wipe `out` and write the public site into it; returns how many posts it holds.\"\"\"\n    posts = content.published_posts(conn)\n    topics = {key: TopicPage(name, f\"tema/{content.slugify(name)}.html\",\n                             [post for post in posts if post.topic == key])\n              for key, name in content.TOPICS.items()}\n\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    shutil.copyfile(settings.TEMPLATES / \"public\" / \"style.css\", out / \"style.css\")\n    env = _environment(topics=list(topics.values()))\n    _write(env, out, \"index.html\", \"public/home.html\")\n    for post in posts:\n        _write(env, out, post_path(post), \"public/post.html\", post=post,\n               topic=topics[post.topic], body_html=markdown.to_html(post.body))\n    return len(posts)\n\n\ndef _environment(**shared: Any) -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n                      autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]))\n    env.filters[\"spanish_date\"] = spanish_date\n    env.globals.update(site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE, post_path=post_path, **shared)\n    return env\n\n\ndef _write(env: Environment, out: Path, path: str, template: str, **context: Any) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Render one page to `out / path`. Its links go through href(), which turns a\n    path from the site root into one relative to this page, percent-encoded.\"\"\"\n    up = \"../\" * path.count(\"/\")\n\n    def href(target: str) -> str:\n        return up + quote(target)\n\n    file = out / path\n    file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    file.write_text(env.get_template(template).render(href=href, **context), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n"}},"apiBlockIndex":3,"requestId":"req_011CfuE6fpb1NdJ3zDcr7iwg","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:tdd","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"19e1c56c-4004-4a66-a56c-c32d60f86611","timestamp":"2026-10-10T20:58:54.616Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"xhigh","perTurnEffort":"xhigh","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"616c13ec-bcd7-460e-a016-8152d9676f65","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written. A draft that reaches the output is a bug.\n  2. Every href is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"../posts/x.html\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves the site from a subfolder. Links are\n     percent-encoded too, so slugs with accents and ñ never break.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content, markdown, settings\nfrom app.content import Post\nfrom app.dates import spanish_date\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TopicPage:\n    \"\"\"A topic's public page: every published post filed under it, newest first.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    path: str  # where it is written, from the site root: \"tema/alineación.html\"\n    posts: list[Post]\n\n\ndef post_path(post: Post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a post's page is written, from the site root.\"\"\"\n    return f\"posts/{post.slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef export_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection, out: Path) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Wipe `out` and write the public site into it; returns how many posts it holds.\"\"\"\n    posts = content.published_posts(conn)\n    topics = {key: TopicPage(name, f\"tema/{content.slugify(name)}.html\",\n                             [post for post in posts if post.topic == key])\n              for key, name in content.TOPICS.items()}\n\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    shutil.copyfile(settings.TEMPLATES / \"public\" / \"style.css\", out / \"style.css\")\n    env = _environment(topics=list(topics.values()))\n    _write(env, out, \"index.html\", \"public/home.html\")\n    for post in posts:\n        _write(env, out, post_path(post), \"public/post.html\", post=post,\n               topic=topics[post.topic], body_html=markdown.to_html(post.body))\n    return len(posts)\n\n\ndef _environment(**shared: Any) -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n                      autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]))\n    env.filters[\"spanish_date\"] = spanish_date\n    env.globals.update(site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE, post_path=post_path, **shared)\n    return env\n\n\ndef _write(env: Environment, out: Path, path: str, template: str, **context: Any) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Render one page to `out / path`. Its links go through href(), which turns a\n    path from the site root into one relative to this page, percent-encoded.\"\"\"\n    up = \"../\" * path.count(\"/\")\n\n    def href(target: str) -> str:\n        return up + quote(target)\n\n    file = out / path\n    file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    file.write_text(env.get_template(template).render(href=href, **context), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":47,"newStart":1,"newLines":76,"lines":["-\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.","+\"\"\"Site export: the public site, written as static HTML from published posts only."," ","-T00 publishes a placeholder home page. Its links go through href(), which turns a","+    path from the site root into one relative to this page, percent-encoded.\"\"\"","+    up = \"../\" * path.count(\"/\")","+","+    def href(target: str) -> str:","+        return up + quote(target)","+","+    file = out / path","+    file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)","+    file.write_text(env.get_template(template).render(href=href, **context), encoding=\"utf-8\")"]}],"originalFile":"\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n            home_path=\"index.html\",\n        )\n    )\n    return out\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"19e1c56c-4004-4a66-a56c-c32d60f86611","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"616c13ec-bcd7-460e-a016-8152d9676f65","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review the working tree against ab8e866 (the T02 commit). The originating ticket is GitHub issue #4 (T03: The leader publishes a post and it appears on the public site); its parent spec is issue #1. The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>I found 11 issues: 2 hard violations of documented standards, 3 judgement calls against documented standards, and 6 baseline smells, which are always judgement calls. CSRF, relative links (`markdown.py` already blocks root paths), sanitising, published-only export, argon2, secrets and dependencies all pass.\n\n**Breaches of documented standards**\n\n- **S1 (hard, conflicts with ADR-003 and the glossary)**: `LIFECYCLE[\"publish\"]` lets the leader publish from both `Status.DRAFT` and `Status.SUBMITTED`, whoever wrote the post. ADR-003 says \"the leader publishes a *submitted* post\", and the glossary entry for *Approve* says \"publish is for submitted posts\". Ticket #4 allows publishing a draft for now. But `docs/agents/domain.md` says an ADR conflict must be flagged, and this one isn't, in the ADR or the code comment. When T04 adds submitting, a member's draft would still be publishable without being submitted.\n- **S2 (judgement, glossary)**: in `tests/test_t00.py`, `test_publish_writes_a_site` and `test_published_html_uses_relative_paths` call the export \"publish\", which the glossary's *Export* entry says to avoid. Renaming could break a rubric check that refers to them by name (the file mentions \"rubric F2\"), so leave them if so.
